changes.description: A monthly themed night ride for women, trans and femme riders, run out of the BICAS community bike shop. No-drop, around 5 to 10 miles. It follows the weekly WTF workshop, which runs Mondays 3–7 pm, so come early if your bike needs work. The June edition is a Pride ride. All WTF-identifying folks welcome; each month's theme is posted on @bicas_wtf.

changes.description: The monthly club ride of the Bay Area's LGBTQ+ cycling club. Two groups, one from Jane Warner Plaza in the Castro (48 miles) and one from Mike's Bikes in Sausalito (24 miles), meet in Tiburon for lunch. No sweep, but regular regroups for slower riders.
